en: Vintage monochrome view of a leafy public square with a central flower bed and fountain in the foreground. Behind the park stands an ornate historic building with arched windows and corner turrets, fronted by a large statue on a pedestal. Streetlamps and surrounding multi‑story urban buildings frame the scene. At the top, printed in red, is the title indicating the location as Chemnitz and the old town hall.
